Check a SUPP– merge

Source: R/supp.R
sv_supp_check.Rd

A supplemental qualifier table (SUPPAE, SUPPQUAL, ...) holds one row per qualifier, named by QNAM and tied to a parent record by USUBJID, IDVAR and IDVARVAL. This checks that the rows can be folded into the parent as one column per QNAM, and reports what would go wrong: rows that match no parent record, a QNAM that repeats for one record, a QNAM that clashes with a parent column or sits at two IDVAR levels, and IDVARVAL values that do not convert to the type of the parent column.

Usage

sv_supp_check(
  parent,
  supp,
  parent_name = "parent",
  supp_name = "supp",
  rdomain = NULL,
  plan = NULL,
  sample_n = 5L
)

sv_supp_key_type(x)

sv_supp_check_json(chk)

Arguments

parent

The parent table: a data frame, or a sideview card (its data and CDISC tag are used).

supp

The SUPP– table: a data frame with USUBJID, IDVAR, IDVARVAL, QNAM and QVAL (and optionally STUDYID, RDOMAIN, QLABEL).

parent_name, supp_name

Names used in messages.

rdomain

The parent domain to merge into. NULL uses the parent card's CDISC domain, else supp_name without its SUPP prefix. Rows are filtered on RDOMAIN only when supp has that column.

plan

A plan from an earlier check. The result's drift says whether the data still fits it.

sample_n

Most rows in each sample.

x

A vector.

chk

A result of sv_supp_check().

Value

A list with status ("ok", "warning" or "error"), plan, n_parent, n_supp, n_matched, n_orphan, orphan_samples, n_other_rdomain, repeats, clashes, two_level, bad_idvarval, columns, preview and drift; or just list(error = ) when the check cannot run.

sv_supp_key_type(): "integer", "double", "character" or NA (a factor counts as character, an integer64 as double). sv_supp_check_json(): the check as JSON text, one-element arrays kept as arrays and NA as null.

Details

IDVARVAL is text; it is converted to the type of the parent's IDVAR column before matching ("1.5" does not become 1 for an integer column). A blank or NA IDVAR means the qualifier belongs to the subject.

Examples

ae <- data.frame(USUBJID = c("S1", "S2"), AESEQ = 1:2, AETERM = c("Rash", "Cough"))
suppae <- data.frame(RDOMAIN = "AE", USUBJID = c("S1", "S2"), IDVAR = "AESEQ",
                     IDVARVAL = c("1", "2"), QNAM = "AETRTEM",
                     QLABEL = "Treatment Emergent", QVAL = c("Y", "N"))
chk <- sv_supp_check(ae, suppae, parent_name = "ae", supp_name = "suppae")
chk$status
#> [1] "ok"
chk$preview
#>   USUBJID AESEQ AETERM AETRTEM
#> 1      S1     1   Rash       Y
#> 2      S2     2  Cough       N
